title: Bill Ray's remote viewing of Buddha

tellings.quote: >> uh they uh Bill Ray I know they had him uh remote view Buddha and that was a uh change life-changing experience for him

plain: In the 1980s, a man named Bill Ray, a member of a military remote viewing unit that tried to see distant places and people with the mind alone, is said to have been asked to remote view the Buddha, and he found it life-changing. Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who served in the unit, tells this as something he knows about Ray, without giving details of what Ray saw.
